t: A four-wheel robot car kit with an ESP32 camera board and many sensors.
steps: Buy the kit from the Freenove Store or Amazon. Buy two high-drain 18650 cells and a charger too.
Download the tutorial PDF and code from the Freenove GitHub page.
Install the CH340 USB driver from the kit files.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the ESP32 board package version named in the tutorial.
Build the car step by step with the tutorial pictures.
Upload the first motor test sketch and watch the wheels spin.
Install the Freenove app on your phone and drive with live video.
meta: Open Board. From $63.99. A few stores.
